en: Black‑and‑white winter view of a busy industrial river port with many long, covered cargo barges moored side by side along a quay. Snow covers the boats and the ground, and there is ice on the water. On the left are cranes, warehouses, rail tracks and freight wagons, with smokestacks and factory buildings visible in the background. At the top of the image there is German text identifying the location as Gröba‑Riesa and mentioning a new harbor and chemical factory.
